li.label: microscopic prickling
li.description: Something is under my skin. It's a faint, metallic itch that I just can't scratch away.

li.label: nanobot gnawing
li.description: The itching has turned into a constant, cold grinding. I can feel them disassembling me one cell at a time.

li.label: metallic assimilation
li.description: The silver is spreading. My nerves are screaming as my organic parts are replaced by cold, unfeeling machines.

li.label: industrial body horror
li.description: I'm being hollowed out. There's more machine than man left, and the swarm won't stop until the last of my flesh is gone.
